statements.text: Small business owners deserve better guidance on how to use artificial intelligence. I co-sponsored the bipartisan AI WISE Act and AI For Main Street Act to address this need. These bills will require the SBA to develop artificial intelligence resources to help small business owners critically evaluate and adopt AI.

Artificial intelligence will revolutionize the way businesses work and humans operate. AI could allow main street businesses to scale their capabilities and perform routine tasks faster and cheaper. However, AI's many risks have incurred costs for small firms.
statements.venue: House Small Business Committee hearing 'How AI Is Shaping the Future of Small Business' (opening statement as Ranking Member)

statements.text: Furthermore, the inherent risk of AI must be addressed through smart and sensible AI regulation. Smart, well-crafted federal regulation will minimize the risk of AI, maximize its benefits, and prevent criminal and unethical use. These regulations are needed to protect all Americans, especially small business owners.
statements.venue: House Small Business Committee hearing 'How AI Is Shaping the Future of Small Business' (opening statement as Ranking Member)

statements.text: I support strong federal AI regulation and I think it is important that we have that. But I am worried that this EO punishes states like California, my home state, that are proactive and forward-thinking enough to harness the benefits of AI while also creating guardrails against potential harms, especially because this EO removes all state laws without putting any safeguards in place.
statements.venue: House Small Business Committee hearing 'How AI Is Shaping the Future of Small Business' (questioning of witnesses)
